fit_reason: Whole SUV, a 2013 Honda CR-V, listed by a private owner in the cars by owner section.
findings: Paint on the hood, doors and rear quarters reflects cleanly with strong gloss in all four exterior shots
Black lower door cladding and bumper trim look dark, not faded
Headlight lenses on the front corners look clear
Cargo area is clean, with the factory protective cover still on the floor
Light dust visible on the front and rear wheel faces and tire sidewalls
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2013 CR-V and it already looks sharp, with glossy paint and a cargo area that still has the factory floor cover on. If you want it fully buyer-ready, we can come to you for a light pre-sale wash, wax and wheel and tire cleanup. Would you like a quote?
